_readme: How to add your own language to the HUD:
1. Copy this file to  locales\<code>.json  in the install folder (%LOCALAPPDATA%\DiscordQuestAgent\locales\de.json for German).
<code> is the language code Discord uses, lower-case: de, fr, pl, pt-br, zh-cn ... Files in that folder survive updates.
2. Translate the values on the right. Keep the keys on the left and every {placeholder} exactly as they are.
3. Restart the agent (Start Menu > Discord Quest Agent). Pick the language in Settings, or leave it on Auto
and it is used whenever Discord runs in that language.
_name is what the language button in Settings shows. Any key you leave out falls back to English.
Send your file in a pull request so everyone gets it: https://github.com/BixiSG/discord-quest-agent
